{{Quote|Oh, well, he was an annoying piece of vermin, wasn't he? No matter. This planet has lots more to choose from.|Ilb Toranda, on Krael|<ref name="Stone and Steel" />}}
'''Ilb Toranda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[:Category:Criminals|criminal]] who lived during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Toranda dispatched the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Krael]] and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Vreego]] to purchase some illicit weapons for him in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the assignment, Vreego [[Death/Legends|murdered]] Krael, and the Rodian subsequently informed Toranda of his actions, via a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="Stone and Steel" />
